title: TOTALWTD over a calendar, by date within one week, is the running sum from the week's Sunday
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( 'Date'[Date], TREATAS ( { "W33-2008" }, 'Date'[WeekKey] ), "Sales WTD", TOTALWTD ( [Total], Weekly ) ) ORDER BY 'Date'[Date]

source.quote: Sales WTD returns the sales from the start of the week
source.supports: the page's query, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS by date with TREATAS on the week, gives running sums from August 10

source.quote: Evaluates the value of the expression for the week to date, in the current context.

derivation: Amount is the day of the month. Each row's date is filtered, so DATESWTD ends on it; W33-2008 starts on August 10: 10, 10+11 = 21, 33, 46, 60, 75, 91.
